utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa, I’m keeping the repair drive list sorted by supply location, who’s bringing tools, and volunteer slots around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderfully organized, Opal—thank you. Just make sure the list reflects the updated plan: Sunday at the community center, and we can shape volunteer slots around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll update the list to show Sunday at the community center and keep the volunteer slots shaped around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Quinn — I’ve only heard about the repair drive second-hand from Marisol so far, and Rosa’s checking the confirmed time and place before we spread anything around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell—best to wait for Rosa’s confirmed time and place before you broadcast it, but I’ve heard Saturday morning is the plan and folks are bringing lamps, bikes, and wobbly things.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s helpful, Quinn — I’ll treat Saturday morning as tentative for now and wait for Rosa’s confirmation before passing it to Vik or anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rey, the repair drive is Saturday morning, so I’m checking our spare parts and tools now—especially anything useful for lamps, wobbly chairs, and bike chains.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—that’s helpful. Mina asked me to focus first on leaky roofs, broken steps, and heaters, but I’ll note lamps, chairs, and bike chains as supplies you’re checking.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds right, Rey—Mina’s list should come first for safety, and I’ll keep the repair-drive supplies separate so Saturday morning doesn’t get muddled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Hana—just to be sure, the repair drive is this weekend, and I’m supposed to ask who’s free around school drop-off and pickup, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds likely, Oren, but I don’t want to confirm the weekend timing or school drop-off/pickup ask until we check with Jules or whoever has the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good thinking, Hana—I’ll hold off before I muddle things again and check with Jules for the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I’m lining up repair drive volunteers around school drop-off and pickup—do you know anyone who’s free in those windows so I can avoid double-booking with Opal’s list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Faye, I might be behind on that—Mara was going to check the latest details, so I’d hate to steer you wrong or clash with Opal’s list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, Noah—if Mara has the latest, could you just point her my way or send me whatever she confirms? I’m only slotting people into the drop-off and pickup windows for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, we don’t have a confirmed time yet, but Sam’s handling the donated tool sorting and sharpening/parts list, and I’ll bring my toolbox plus a spare drill set once the schedule lands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I’ll note Sam on tools and you for the toolbox and drill set, and I’ll pass it along quietly once the time is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Uli—once you hear the confirmed time, just give me a nudge and I’ll make sure the toolbox and drill set are ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Mina, I’m checking in while I’m still out on errands—have you heard a confirmed time for the repair drive or seen any repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No confirmed time yet, Ira. I’m waiting on Rey’s list today—roofs, steps, heaters first, and who’s actually available before we set anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks Mina—I’ll keep an ear out for Rey’s list and let Eli know the priorities are roofs, steps, and heaters before we settle on a time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Vik, I’m still waiting on the confirmed start time, but Tess is checking and making a simple repair list so everyone knows what to bring Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Eli—I’ll tell folks Tess is checking the start time and making a simple repair list for Saturday morning, but I’ll hold off on specifics until it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s perfect, Vik—let’s keep it general for now, and once Tess confirms the time and list, we can share the same clear message with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Tess, I’m helping Gus with the repair drive by sorting donated tools and labeling anything dull or missing parts, so I’ll bring my clipboard and labels on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Sam, that’s a huge help—bring those labels Saturday morning, and I’m still double-checking the exact start time so nobody’s left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I’ll plan on Saturday morning and keep an eye out for the exact start time so I can be there when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Kira, I’m still waiting on Rey’s list today, so I don’t want to announce anything yet. Once we have the exact repairs and availability, we can name one collector and then tell the block clearly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, that makes sense—can you confirm with me once Rey’s list is in and you’ve got the collector named, before anything goes out to the block?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll confirm with you first—no block message until Rey’s list is in and we have one clear collector named.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late again—I’m covering the sign-up table for the first hour, but I’m still looking for the forms and repair crew list. Have you seen either of those?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Forms are in the blue folder by the tool bins, and the repair crew list is clipped to the clipboard Sam brought. Thanks for covering the first hour.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Leo—I’ll grab the blue folder and Sam’s clipboard, then get the sign-up table moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Bo, I told Noah I’d check with the group today before anyone promises specifics, so I’m going to confirm who’s handling the tool list and sign-ups first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Mara—I’d only heard Leo needed screwdrivers, pliers, and maybe an hour Saturday. Just let me know who’s tracking it and the start time when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Bo—I’ll treat that as tentative for now and circle back once I’ve confirmed the coordinator and Saturday start time with the group.
